recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following a powerful storm that killed at least 111 people in Uttar Pradesh, the **Uttar Pradesh** government directed Ministers to assess the situation and provide financial assistance. The **Congress** party criticized the **Union Government's** lack of response, highlighting the condolences from Russian President Vladimir Putin as evidence of their insensitivity.  The **Uttar Pradesh** Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced a ₹4 lakh compensation for families who lost loved ones and directed officials to ensure relief for farmers and livestock owners.

recent_articles.title: Unseasonal storms leave 111 dead in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 111 people were killed and hundreds more injured in **Uttar Pradesh** after a powerful storm brought heavy rain, strong winds, and thunderstorms.  The **U.P. Relief Commissioner’s office** reported damage to homes, trees, and electric poles across 26 districts. **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** directed officials to provide aid to victims and release compensation. **Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav** called for comprehensive relief efforts and urged the government to assess losses and ensure insurance payments.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: Prateek Yadav, Mulayam Singh Yadav’s younger son, passes away in Lucknow - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prateek Yadav**, the son of former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister **Mulayam Singh Yadav** and husband of BJP leader **Aparna Bisht Yadav**, passed away on Wednesday morning at the age of 38.  He was pronounced dead after being rushed to a hospital in Lucknow where doctors could not determine the cause of death.  **Yogi Adityanath**, the current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, expressed condolences and offered prayers for the departed soul.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet expanded with six new Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, expanded his state cabinet by adding six new ministers and elevating two to independent charge.  **Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary** and **Manoj Kumar Pandey** were sworn in as Cabinet Ministers, while **Chaudhary** previously served as State BJP president and **Pandey** switched from the Samajwadi Party (SP) before the 2024 Lok Sabha election.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Cabinet 2026: From Dilip Ghosh to Agnimitra Paul, Ministers who were sworn in along with Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, newly sworn in as the Chief Minister of West Bengal, inducted five new ministers into his cabinet on Saturday. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, J. P. Nadda, and Dharmendra Pradhan**, among other BJP leaders.  **Dilip Ghosh**, a senior BJP leader who secured victory in the Kharagpur seat, **Agnimitra Paul**, a fashion designer-turned-legislator who won Asansol Dakshin, **Ashok Kirtania**, a BJP stalwart who gained victory in Bangaon Uttar, and **Kshudiram Tudu**, a former school teacher from Ranibandh (ST) constituency, were among the newly appointed ministers.  **Nisith Pramanik**, a key face of BJP from North Bengal, was also inducted into the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh government scraps smart prepaid meter system; shifts all consumers to postpaid mode - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Uttar Pradesh** government has decided to discontinue the smart prepaid electricity meter system and convert all existing devices to postpaid mode.  **Energy Minister A.K. Sharma** announced this decision, citing consumer convenience and grievances following growing protests over alleged billing irregularities. The new arrangement will see consumers receive bills after consumption, with bills for May 2026 issued in June. **Central Electricity Regulatory Commission Advisory Committee member Avadhesh Kumar Verma**, who represents the Uttar Pradesh Rajya Vidyut Upbhokta Parishad, welcomed the decision but criticized the delay and alleged that the state government was pressured by the central regulatory body into taking action.

recent_articles.title: Yogi Adityanath launches first phase of Census 2027 in Uttar Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister**, launched the first phase of Census-2027, a digital census aimed at supporting data-driven planning and welfare delivery. The exercise, running from May 7 to May 21, allows citizens to self-enumerate online before enumerators begin door-to-door verification across **Uttar Pradesh**.  The second phase will involve individual enumeration and caste enumeration, including coverage of forest villages for the first time.  **Adityanath** emphasized the importance of accurate census data for improving infrastructure, education, healthcare, social security, and welfare schemes.

recent_articles.title: How ‘bulldozer justice’ undermines the law - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A five-year-old girl gifted a bulldozer toy to **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, sparking concerns about the normalization of "bulldozer justice" and its potential influence on impressionable minds.  **Adityanath** returned the gift and advised the child to focus on her studies, but the incident highlights the public's acceptance of this political symbol and its implications for extrajudicial action within the state.

recent_articles.title: Strict action against anyone forcibly occupying others' land: Yogi Adityanath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, addressed citizens during a 'janata darshan' program at the Gorakhnath temple in Gorakhpur. He assured residents that his government would effectively address their concerns, including illegal land grabbing, and instructed officials to take legal action against perpetrators.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal: Modi's BJP conquers one of India's toughest political frontiers
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won a decisive victory in West Bengal, marking a significant breakthrough for **Narendra Modi** and his 12-year reign.  This unexpected outcome comes after years of the party's struggle to gain traction in the state, which has traditionally been dominated by the Trinamool Congress (TMC). The BJP's success is attributed to a combination of factors, including its aggressive welfare pitch, sharpened Hindu consolidation efforts, and a focus on alleged corruption within the TMC. This victory will likely have far-reaching implications for the BJP's future trajectory, potentially solidifying **Amit Shah**'s position as Modi's successor.

recent_articles.title: U.P. CM announces wage reform, warns industrial unrest will harm progress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, Chief Minister of **Uttar Pradesh**, announced the formation of a new wage board to ensure equitable wages for workers, particularly those in industries with 10 or more employees. He emphasized the interdependence of industry and labor, stating that both must thrive for mutual success.  **Adityanath** also revealed plans to provide free annual health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh to workers in industrial regions through collaboration with insurance companies and entrepreneurs.
